messages.content: Welcome to Vokko. A familiar place, built in the open.
This is our first local workspace. Switch channels, look around, and try writing a message in the desktop app.
You are looking at sample conversations. Accounts, networking, and voice are not connected yet.
An independent Rust engine, shared commands, and a familiar interface. This is where we start building Vokko.
